048/**
049 * A utility for working with <dfn>bean types</dfn>.
050 *
051 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
052 *
053 * @see #beanTypes(TypeMirror)
054 *
055 * @see #legalBeanType(TypeMirror)
056 */
057public final class BeanTypes extends Types {
058
059
060  /*
061   * Static fields.
062   */
063
064
065  private static final Logger LOGGER = System.getLogger(BeanTypes.class.getName());
066
067
068  /*
069   * Instance fields.
070   */
071
072
073  // TODO: is this cache actually worth it?
074  private final Map<TypeMirror, BeanTypeList> beanTypesCache;
075
076
077  /*
078   * Constructors.
079   */
080
081
082  /**
083   * Creates a new {@link BeanTypes}.
084   *
085   * @param domain a {@link Domain}; must not be {@code null}
086   *
087   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code domain} is {@code null}
088   */
089  public BeanTypes(final Domain domain) {
090    super(domain);
091    this.beanTypesCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
092  }
093
094
095  /*
096   * Instance methods.
097   */
098
099
100  /**
101   * Returns a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
102   * TypeMirror} bears.
103   *
104   * <p>The returned {@link BeanTypeList} may be empty.</p>
105   *
106   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
107   *
108   * @return a {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types} that the supplied {@link
109   * TypeMirror} bears; never {@code null}
110   *
111   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
112   *
113   * @microbean.nullability This method never returns {@code null}.
114   *
115   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and returns determinate values.
116   *
117   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
118   *
119   * @see #supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
120   */
121  public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final TypeMirror t) {
122    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#assignable_parameters
123    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types
124    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#managed_bean_types
125    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#producer_field_types
126    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#producer_method_types
127    final Domain d = this.domain();
128    return switch (t.getKind()) {
129    case ARRAY ->
130      this.beanTypesCache.computeIfAbsent(t, t0 -> BeanTypeList.of(d,
131                                                                   (legalBeanType(t0) ?
132                                                                    List.of(t0, d.javaLangObject().asType()) :
133                                                                    List.of())));
134    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT ->
135      this.beanTypesCache.computeIfAbsent(t, t0 -> BeanTypeList.of(d,
136                                                                   List.of(t0, d.javaLangObject().asType())));
137    case DECLARED, TYPEVAR ->
138      this.beanTypesCache.computeIfAbsent(t, t0 -> BeanTypeList.of(d,
139                                                                   this.supertypes(t0, BeanTypes::legalBeanType)));
140    default ->
141      BeanTypeList.of(d, List.of());
142    };
143  }
144
145  /**
146   * Clears caches that may be used internally by this {@link BeanTypes}.
147   *
148   * @microbean.idempotency This method may clear internal state but otherwise has no side effects.
149   *
150   * @microbean.threadsafety This method is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.
151   */
152  public final void clearCaches() {
153    this.beanTypesCache.clear();
154  }
155
156
157  /*
158   * Static methods.
159   */
160
161
162  /**
163   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>legal bean type</dfn> as defined by
164   * the <a href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types">CDI
165   * specification</a>.
166   *
167   * <p>Legal bean types are, exactly:</p>
168   *
169   * <ol>
170   *
171   * <li>{@linkplain TypeKind#ARRAY Array} types whose {@linkplain ArrayType#getComponentType() component type}s are
172   * legal bean types</li>
173   *
174   * <li>{@linkplain TypeKind#isPrimitive() Primitive} types</li>
175   *
176   * <li>{@linkplain TypeKind#DECLARED Declared} types that <dfn>contain</dfn> no {@linkplain TypeKind#WILDCARD wildcard
177   * type}s for every interpretation and level of containment</li>
178   *
179   * </ol>
180   *
181   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
182   *
183   * @return {@code true} if and only if {@code t} is a legal bean type; {@code false} otherwise
184   *
185   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
186   *
187   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types CDI Specification, version
188   * 4.1, section 2.2.1
189   *
190   * @see <a
191   * href="https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118">CDI-502</a>
192   *
193   * @see <a href="https://github.com/jakartaee/cdi/issues/823">CDI issue 823</a>
194   *
195   * @see <a href="https://issues.redhat.com/browse/WELD-1492">WELD-1492</a>
196   *
197   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
198   *
199   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
200   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
201   */
202  public static final boolean legalBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
203    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#assignable_parameters
204    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types
205    return switch (t.getKind()) {
206
207    // "A bean type may be an array type."
208    //
209    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] An array type whose component type is not a legal bean
210    // type"
211    case ARRAY -> {
212      if (!legalBeanType(((ArrayType)t).getComponentType())) { // note recursion
213        if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
214          LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a component type that is an illegal bean type (" + ((ArrayType)t).getComponentType() + ")");
215        }
216        yield false;
217      }
218      yield true;
219    }
220
221    // "A bean type may be a primitive type. Primitive types are considered to be identical to their corresponding
222    // wrapper types in java.lang."
223    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT -> true;
224
225    // "A bean type may be a parameterized type with actual [non-wildcard, non-type-variable, see below] type parameters
226    // [arguments] and type variables." (A bean type may be a parameterized type whose type arguments are either array
227    // types, declared types, or type variables.)
228    //
229    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] A parameterized type that contains [anywhere, see
230    // below] a wildcard type parameter [argument] is not a legal bean type."
231    //
232    // Some ink has been spilled on what it means for a "parameterized" (generic) type to "contain" a "wildcard type
233    // parameter [argument]" (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502). Because it turns out that an "actual type" is a
234    // non-wildcard, non-type-variable type, it follows that *no* wildcard type argument appearing *anywhere* in a bean
235    // type's declaration is permitted. Note that this definition of "actual type" does not appear in the CDI
236    // specification, but only in a (closed) JIRA issue raised against the specification
237    // (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118):
238    // "An actual type is a type that is not a wildcard nor [sic] an unresolved [sic] type variable."
239    //
240    // This still seems way overstrict to me but there you have it.
241    case DECLARED -> {
242      for (final TypeMirror ta : ((DeclaredType)t).getTypeArguments()) {
243        if (ta.getKind() != TypeKind.TYPEVAR && !legalBeanType(ta)) { // note recursion
244          if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
245            LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a type argument that is an illegal bean type (" + ta + ")");
246          }
247          yield false;
248        }
249      }
250      yield true;
251    }
252
253    // "A type variable is not a legal bean type." (Nothing else is either.)
254    default -> {
255      if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
256        LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " is an illegal bean type");
257      }
258      yield false;
259    }
260    };
261  }  
262
263  /**
264   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror)
265   * legal}, {@linkplain TypeKind#DECLARED declared}, <dfn>proxiable bean type</dfn> as defined by the <a
266   * href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable">CDI specification</a>.
267   *
268   * @param t a {@link TypeMirror}; must not be {@code null}
269   *
270   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>proxiable bean type</dfn>
271   *
272   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
273   *
274   * @see #proxiableElement(Element)
275   *
276   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.1,
277   * section 3.10
278   *
279   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
280   *
281   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
282   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
283   */
284  public static final boolean proxiableBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
285    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable
286    return
287      t.getKind() == TypeKind.DECLARED &&
288      legalBeanType(t) &&
289      proxiableElement(((DeclaredType)t).asElement());
290  }
291
292  /**
293   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Element} is an {@linkplain ElementKind#INTERFACE
294   * interface}, or a <dfn>proxiable</dfn> {@linkplain ElementKind#CLASS class}, as defined by the <a
295   * href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable">CDI specification</a>.
296   *
297   * @param e an {@link Element}; must not be {@code null}
298   *
299   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Element} is <dfn>proxiable</fn>
300   *
301   * @excepiton NullPointerException if {@code e} is {@code null}
302   *
303   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.1,
304   * section 3.10
305   *
306   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
307   *
308   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
309   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
310   */
311  static final boolean proxiableElement(final Element e) {
312    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable
313    switch (e.getKind()) {
314    case CLASS:
315      if (e.getModifiers().contains(FINAL) ||
316          e.getModifiers().contains(SEALED) ||
317          ((QualifiedNameable)e).getQualifiedName().contentEquals("java.lang.Object")) { // cheap optimization for a common case
318        return false;
319      }
320      boolean hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor = false;
321      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
322        switch (ee.getKind()) {
323        case CONSTRUCTOR:
324          if (!hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor &&
325              !ee.getModifiers().contains(PRIVATE) &&
326              ((ExecutableElement)ee).getParameters().isEmpty()) {
327            hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor = true;
328          }
329          break;
330        case METHOD:
331          final Collection<?> modifiers = ((ExecutableElement)ee).getModifiers();
332          if (modifiers.contains(FINAL) &&
333              !modifiers.contains(STATIC) &&
334              !modifiers.contains(PRIVATE)) {
335            return false;
336          }
337          break;
338        }
339      }
340      return hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor;
341    case INTERFACE:
342      return true;
343    default:
344      return false;
345    }
346  }
347
348}
